title: Retire per-issue handoff files in favor of issue bodies and labels
changes_summary: Rewrote handoff-check.ps1 to parse hibiki:handoff-v1 blocks from GitHub issue bodies; lifecycle labels replace status enum (claimed=in_progress, in-review=ready_for_review, closed=done).

Updated AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/AI_HANDOFF.md, docs/START_HERE.md, docs/PROJECT_MAP.md, docs/ai/MULTI_AGENT.md, docs/ai/CHANGE_CONTRACT.yml, docs/ai/HANDOFF_SCHEMA.json, and docs/specs/SPEC-0004 to reference issue-body handoff blocks instead of docs/tasks/active/<issue>.md files.
Rewrote .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ai-task.yml to instruct embedding the handoff block in the issue body; updated PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md accordingly.
Deleted schemas/task-handoff-v2.schema.json and all docs/tasks/ content (66 tracked files).
Updated tools/context-pack.ps1 to read handoff data via gh issue view instead of a local file.
Updated tools/docs-check.ps1 required list and self-test paths to remove docs/tasks references.
Updated BASELINE.md verification summary from 85 to 80 required entries.
limitations: This is a process/documentation change only; no product code or DSP behavior was modified.
The new protocol depends on gh CLI access for handoff parsing; offline environments cannot run handoff-check against real issues.
Existing open issues that still use the old file-based protocol must migrate before their next handoff update.
